title: The 10 Best Spirit Levels
subtitle: Torpedo, 24-inch and long spirit levels and level sets, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A level tells you when something is truly flat or plumb, from a picture frame to a deck ledger. We ranked 10 best-sellers from STABILA, CRAFTSMAN, ARROW, Franklin Sensors, Amazon Basics and value brands on rating, review volume and features (a magnetic edge, an aluminum frame, a 45-degree vial, 24 inches or longer and a stated accuracy).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: Amazon Basics 9-Inch Magnetic Torpedo Level and Ruler, 180/90/45 Degree Bubbles

specs.extras: Inch and metric ruler, magnetic edge

products.verdict: The most-reviewed level here: a 9-inch magnetic torpedo level with three vials, a stated 1 mm/m accuracy and a built-in ruler, for under $10.
products.best_for: Everyday jobs: hanging pictures and shelves, setting appliances, checking pipe.
products.skip_if: You need to level anything longer than a shelf.

products.name: Firecore 9-Inch Magnetic Torpedo Level with 3 Bubbles (FSL230PC)
products.verdict: The best-selling level here: a 9-inch magnetic torpedo level with rubber end caps, for about $6.
products.best_for: A spare level for the junk drawer or truck.
products.skip_if: You want an aluminum frame or a stated accuracy.

products.name: WORKPRO 12-Inch Magnetic Torpedo Level with Multi-Pitch Vial (W062071AE)

specs.extras: Pitch vial reads slope in 1/8 in per foot steps; over 2 lb magnet

products.verdict: A 12-inch aluminum torpedo level with a fourth vial that reads drain-pipe slope in 1/8-inch-per-foot steps.
products.best_for: Plumbers and DIYers running drain lines.
cons: Listing also states 0.001 in/ft, which doesn't match 1 mm/m

products.name: CRAFTSMAN 9-Inch Magnetic Torpedo Level (CMHT43191)
products.verdict: A brand-name 9-inch aluminum torpedo level rated 4.7 stars on 1,859 reviews. The listing gives almost no detail.
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a CRAFTSMAN in the toolbox.

products.name: ARROW 3-Piece Spirit Level Set, 9, 16 and 48-Inch, with Carrying Bag (AHT06007)

products.name: MAYES 10101 24-Inch Level, Made in USA

specs.extras: Ruled edge with 1/8 and 1/16 in marks

products.best_for: Hanging cabinets, shelves and frames on painted walls.

products.name: PREXISO 2-in-1 Laser Level, 100 ft Point and 30 ft Line, with 12-Inch Magnetic Spirit Level (P1P20)

specs.extras: 100 ft laser point, 30 ft laser line, lit vials, V-groove

products.name: DOWELL 12-Inch Magnetic Torpedo Level (HY030660)
products.verdict: A 12-inch aluminum magnetic torpedo level with top-view vials and rubber ends, for under $10.

avoid.name: URASISTO 5-Piece Spirit Level Set, 10, 16, 24, 32 and 48-Inch (YST040919)
avoid.flag: Claims accuracy 12 times better than STABILA's
avoid.verdict: A five-level set that claims an accuracy no ordinary bubble level reaches.
reasons: It claims 'maximum accuracy of 0.0005-inch/ft', about 0.04 mm per meter. STABILA, which builds some of the most accurate levels sold, certifies its Pro levels to 0.5 mm per meter.
The same claim appears word for word on URASISTO's 3-piece set, so it reads as copy, not a measured spec.
It's rated 4.4 stars on 191 reviews. The ARROW 3-piece set costs less and doesn't oversell its accuracy.

buyers_guide.a: A 9- to 12-inch torpedo level handles pictures, shelves and appliances. 24 inches suits cabinets and windows. 48 inches is for framing, doors and decks, where a short level misses bows.
Good spirit levels are accurate to about 0.5 to 1 mm per meter. Check a level by reading it, flipping it end for end on the same spot and reading again; the bubble should sit the same.
Magnets hold the level on steel studs, pipe, conduit and machinery, leaving both hands free. They're no help on wood.
A pitch vial reads slope, typically 1/8 or 1/4 inch per foot, the range used for drain pipes and gutters.
Digital and light-up levels are easier to read at odd angles and in the dark. Bubble levels never need batteries.
